blocks.title: Qarz aur sood
blocks.text: Qarz udhaar liya hua paisa hai jo sood ke saath wapas karna hota hai. Sood udhaar ki laagat hai, aam taur par qarz ki raqam ka percentage.
Multan ka chai khana 10% salana par Rs 100,000 udhaar leta hai: kul wapsi = 100,000 + 10% x 100,000 = ek saal baad Rs 110,000.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: 8% par ek saal ke liye Rs 50,000 par kitna wapas hoga, aur sharah kul par kaise asar dalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Sood = 8% x 50,000 = Rs 4,000, to kul Rs 54,000. Zyada sharah sood ko usi nisbat se barhati hai; 10% par Rs 55,000 hota.

blocks.prompt: Maali intezam ki ahmiyat aur budget aur cash flow karobari kaam par kaise asar dalte hain, samjhaiye (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Maali intezam karobar ko zinda rakhta hai: munafe ki hifazat ke liye revenue aur kharche ka hisab, budget se kharche ka mansooba, saaman aur hangami haalat ke liye bachat, aur yeh faisla ke kab qarz sood ke qabil hai. Budget batata hai ke paisa kahan jana chahiye aur zyada kharche se khabardar karta hai. Cash flow, yaani paisa aane aur jane ka waqt, ahem hai kyunke munafa wala karobar bhi nakam ho jata hai agar kiraya aur tankhwahein waqt par ada na kar sake; cash flow ka mansooba aise khala se bachata hai. Chapter cash flow nahi samjhata; yeh hissa aam ilm hai.
